title: GM Agrees to $220 Million Settlement Over Driver Data Sales
excerpt: General Motors will pay $220 million to resolve allegations that it improperly sold driver and location data to data brokers.
body_html:
General Motors has reached a $220 million agreement to resolve allegations that the company improperly sold driver and location information to data brokers.

The settlement addresses a complaint brought forward by a coalition consisting of 36 United States attorneys general. Under the terms of the agreement, General Motors is required to restrict the amount of driving data it gathers.

Additionally, the automaker must secure explicit consent from individuals regarding the collection of their information.
